description: Source code for the Browser class in Playwright, managing browser instances, contexts, pages, and related operations.

classes.name: Browser
classes.description: Represents a browser instance, providing methods to create contexts, pages, and manage browser lifecycle.

methods.name: from
methods.description: Static method to get Browser instance from channel object.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes a new Browser instance with event handlers.

methods.name: browserType
methods.description: Returns the type of the browser.

methods.name: newContext
methods.description: Creates a new browser context with optional settings.

methods.name: _newContextForReuse
methods.description: Creates a new context for reuse.

methods.name: _disconnectFromReusedContext
methods.description: Disconnects from a reused context.

methods.name: _innerNewContext
methods.description: Internal method to create a new context, optionally for reuse.

methods.name: _connectToBrowserType
methods.description: Associates the browser with a specific browser type and options.

methods.name: _didCreateContext
methods.description: Handles post-creation setup for a new context.

methods.name: _setupBrowserContext
methods.description: Configures a browser context with default settings.

methods.name: contexts
methods.description: Returns all active browser contexts.

methods.name: version
methods.description: Returns the browser version.

methods.name: newPage
methods.description: Creates a new page in a new context.

methods.name: isConnected
methods.description: Checks if the browser is still connected.

methods.name: newBrowserCDPSession
methods.description: Creates a new Chrome DevTools Protocol session.

methods.name: _launchServer
methods.description: Launches a server for the browser.

methods.name: startTracing
methods.description: Starts tracing for a page.

methods.name: stopTracing
methods.description: Stops tracing and saves to file if specified.

methods.name: [Symbol.asyncDispose]
methods.description: Asynchronous disposal method to close the browser.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes the browser, optionally with a reason.

methods.name: _didClose
methods.description: Handles cleanup after browser closes.
